title: Adaptation
hook: Last year's best offer isn't guaranteed this year. The market moved on.
explainer: The market moves either way. Move slower and you're losing ground.
sop: Score Adaptation Speed and Change Speed 1 to 10.
Update anything the market is outpacing.
equation_example: Adaptation Speed 6 ÷ Change Speed 8 = 0.75. Under 1, the world is quietly outpacing you.
question: Pick one old tactic and check if it still works.
closing_statement: Last year's win isn't this year's proof.
